name: devcmd
title: Devcmd
description: This extension allows you to quickly open a Windows terminal in any folder path you specify and run custom commands directly from Raycast, streamlining your development workflow by letting you manage projects and execute scripts without leaving your launcher.

commands.name: index
commands.title: Devcmd
commands.description: Help you run commands of the most usuable coms for frameworks and clis.
commands.subtitle: Run commands on terminal with one click

" && exit 1
